Game Overview

Mr And Mrs Santa Christmas Adventure is a dress up game built around embark on a heartwarming Christmas mission with Mrs. Santa, as you heal injuries and repair the sleigh. Engage in delightful point-and-click recovery gameplay, using visual cues to guide you through medical tasks and creative dress-up sessions. Spread joy and make the holidays magical again!

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Mr And Mrs Santa Christmas Adventure is easy to pick up. Embark on a heartwarming Christmas mission with Mrs. Santa, as you heal injuries and repair the sleigh. Engage in delightful point-and-click recovery gameplay, using visual cues to guide you through medical tasks and creative dress-up sessions. Spread joy and make the holidays magical again!
